sources.note: Inspected owner-supplied teodora-moscoso-elementary-school.png on 2026-10-08; capture date unknown. URL locates the site. Two identifiable small crowns and a compact green pocket at the northwest corner of the courtyard. Narrow central/east exposed concrete links retained. Southern adjacent roofs are not outdoor court/lawn; no distinguishable low hedge in this tight crop. Small central roof, west roof and long east roof; only narrow paving and a few visible canopy positions are supported. Independent excluded check errors: 0.77 m, 1.52 m. Visible crown centers are fitted to clear trunks within the observed crown footprint (maximum seven metres); crowns may overhang roofs and roads. Crown widths in the dense belts are estimated from image pixels against their matched local roof scale; existing circular crowns approximate irregular/elliptical image crowns. Complete mapped roofs, pitches, full-width paths/roads, water and farmland remain unchanged. Planted islands take precedence over exposed paving; ground under opaque canopy is not invented. No surveyed boundary, species, construction date or exact inventory inferred; no bitmap ships.
